upstream_supplement_rule: Reconstruct against the exact JEI 3.6.8 missing-key set. Never carry a G3 supplement entry forward if JEI 3.6.8 now owns that key. Existing upstream keys are never overridden by G4 without explicit approval.

special_cases.fr_FR: Upstream was complete for JEI 3.3.3 but is unchanged while G4 adds three normal keys, so it now receives exactly those three missing keys.
special_cases.ko_KR: gui.jei.category.craftingTable is absent upstream and its English meaning changed from Crafting Table to Crafting, so the addon-owned missing-key translation is explicitly revised to 제작.
special_cases.ru_RU: JEI 3.6.8 upstream now owns most keys that were supplied by the G3 supplement. Keep only the two still-missing color-search keys inherited from G3 plus the two new hide-laggy-model keys.
special_cases.zh_CN: JEI 3.6.8 upstream now owns all previously supplemented normal keys. Supply only the three G4-added keys still missing upstream.

debug_policy: The three upstream DEBUG description keys remain in English for all complete addon locales.
fallback_policy: If translation confidence is insufficient, preserve the existing documented English fallback rather than inventing a translation. No new fallback locale is introduced by G4.
